title: Aromatic Chicken Stew
description: A hearty and comforting stew made with tender chicken, aromatic spices, and fresh vegetables.

ingredients.name: aromatic spices (e.g. thyme, rosemary, bay leaves)

instructions: Heat oil in a large pot over medium-high heat.
Add the chicken and cook until browned, about 5 minutes.
Add the onion, carrots, and celery, and cook until the vegetables are tender, about 5 minutes.
Add the potatoes, aromatic spices, salt, and pepper, and stir to combine.
Pour in enough broth to cover the ingredients, and bring to a boil.
Reduce heat to low and simmer, covered, for 20-25 minutes, or until the chicken is cooked through and the potatoes are tender.
Serve hot, garnished with fresh herbs if desired.
